text: Marta: Heads-up — staging smoke tests failed during the runtime deploy; looks like a doc lint error blocking the deploy. I ran the docs-lint job and saw an orphan anchor + missing frontmatter on a runbook. Ethan: which runbook? paste the error? Marta: ``` Error: orphan-anchor 'restore-db' in docs/runbooks/maintenance.md:40 DocsLint: frontmatter missing required key 'owner' in docs/runbooks/maintenance.md CI job: docs-lint-staging #23 failed ``` Kai: I can pick the PR; quick question — do we prefer adding `owner: eng-runbooks` or a person's handle? Marta: add `owner: eng-runbooks` for now, we can follow up with individual ownership later. Kai: ok grabbing it now, will also add the missing anchor: `` and a one-line note. docs-bot: docs-scan finished: 2 findings (1 orphan anchor, 1 missing frontmatter) — https://ci/build/23 Kai: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 — small sed fix + frontmatter Ethan: nice, lemme smoke test staging once it's merged Marta: merged & deployed to staging, ran the smoke tests — all green :tada: Kai: :shipit: I'll add a follow-up task to assign an individual owner in the backlog Ethan: can you add a changelog bullet? ppl on oncall might want to know Kai: added to the runbook changelog in the PR Marta: thanks all, closing the loop — ping me if anything else flares up
